text:
Jamie (AE): Hey team — Froth Labs POC is greenlit but procurement hit two blockers: they need a PO on the order form and Legal flagged a DPA clause change. Can we get a quick path to sign? :raised_hands:
Maria (Legal): Thanks Jamie. Can you paste the exact DPA redline they requested? Is this a material change or just wording?
Jamie (AE): They attached a PDF but the ask is basically: add 'data subject rights processing' paragraph and remove our standard limitation of liability cap for customer data processing. They also want the contract to reference EU data residency (AWS eu-west-1).
Elena (Customer Success): Customer is on a short timeline — POC start next Monday. They said procurement will only process with a PO and signature.
Sam (Solutions Eng): Technical note: for eu-west-1 residency we already have a region pinned for their Dedicated trial. No infra blocker. Was the MSA version v3.2?
Jamie (AE): Yes, v3.2 order form + MSA v1.8. I uploaded a snippet of the order form to the shared folder: https://drive.redwood/froth/poc-orderform.pdf
Maria (Legal): OK. Removing the liability cap for data processing is non-starter. Possible compromise: add narrow carve-out limited to legal judgments or statutory obligations, but keep commercial cap. I'll draft language.
Nate (Finance): On the PO: we can accept PO numbers on the order form, but for accounting we need the invoice billing contact and remit-to added. Jamie — can you confirm the billing email?
Jamie (AE): Billing contact is finance@frothlabs.com, PO will be submitted within 48 hours after signature. They might also request Net30.
Nate (Finance): Net30 is fine if we get a signed order form + PO. Need to confirm who signs — legal wants an authorized signatory.
Maria (Legal): I'll prepare a narrow DPA amendment and flag the liability cap. If they push hard, we can offer a short-term exception limited to the POC (30 days) and revisit at production. Is that acceptable business-wise?
Elena (Customer Success): POC is 30 days. If we can do a 30-day exception that'd unblock them. Customer committed to the trial engineering resources.
Sam (Solutions Eng): For the SLA: they asked for 99.9 for Dedicated during POC. Our standard trial SLA is best-effort; Dedicated SLA requires a Dedicated commitment. Can Sales offer a service credit if we miss a target?
Jamie (AE): They asked for a formal SLA in the order form. I told them we'd escalate. Maria — can we offer a limited service credit pledge for the POC?
Maria (Legal): We can offer a goodwill credit (e.g., pro-rata credit) limited to the fees paid for the POC, documented in a short addendum. I'll draft an addendum: 'POC Addendum — limited service credit, no change to core SLA.'
Nate (Finance): Make sure the addendum states invoice and PO workflow clearly. Also need to ensure billing address and tax info are attached before invoicing.
Maria (Legal): Draft ready, adding a POC-specific clause and the EU residency reference. Posting below (snippet):

```
POC ADDENDUM (30 days):
- Limited service credit equal to fees paid for the POC in the event of material downtime > 12 hours in a 30-day period.
- No amendment to MSA liability cap except for data-protection statutory fines.
- Data processing: Customer data to be stored and processed in EU (eu-west-1) for the duration of the POC.
```

Sam (Solutions Eng): That wording looks workable. Should we also include contact info for incident escalation? (ops@redwood.io)
Maria (Legal): Yes will add ops@redwood.io.
Jamie (AE): Great. Next steps — Maria to upload redlined MSA + addendum, Nate to confirm billing flow, I will route to Froth procurement. Can signflow-bot help with signature routing? :robot_face:
signflow-bot: New signature request created. Link: https://signflow.redwood/requests/FR-1776. Status: pending approver list.
Elena (Customer Success): I'll schedule a 15-min call with Froth procurement tomorrow to walk the PO and invoicing. Jamie, put me on the invite.
Jamie (AE): Will do. Maria — ETA for the redline?
Maria (Legal): I'll post redline + addendum by EOD today. If they push to remove the cap entirely, escalate back to me before promising anything.
Nate (Finance): Once redline is posted, I can confirm Net30 and set billing contact. Also will add tax fields to the order form.
Jamie (AE): Thanks everyone. Tagging @Froth procurement in the customer thread once redline is uploaded. :thumbsup:
Elena (Customer Success): :rocket:
Maria (Legal): Uploaded: https://drive.redwood/froth/redlines/msa_v1.8_froth_redline.pdf — please review and comment by 3pm.
Jamie (AE): Reviewing now. If legal + finance sign off, I'll request signature routing and attach PO when they provide it.
signflow-bot: Reminder scheduled in 24 hours for outstanding approvers on request FR-1776.
